FIBA competition: Basketball Champions League Americas

Source: R/fiba_competitions.R
fiba_bcla_competition.Rd

Per-competition aliases of the FIBA wrappers for Basketball Champions League Americas (GDAP competition family 110), named as in sdv-py. Season rule: END year (2024-25 = 2025).

Usage

fiba_bcla_editions(season = NULL, to_season = NULL, return_parsed = TRUE)

fiba_bcla_schedule(season = NULL, comp = NULL, return_parsed = TRUE)

fiba_bcla_standings(season = NULL, comp = NULL, return_parsed = TRUE)

fiba_bcla_teams(season = NULL, comp = NULL, return_parsed = TRUE)

fiba_bcla_player_box(game_id, season = NULL, comp = NULL, return_parsed = TRUE)

fiba_bcla_team_box(game_id, season = NULL, comp = NULL, return_parsed = TRUE)

fiba_bcla_pbp(game_id, season = NULL, comp = NULL, return_parsed = TRUE)

fiba_bcla_shots(game_id, season = NULL, comp = NULL, return_parsed = TRUE)

Arguments

game_id

FIBA game id (game_id in the schedule).

season

Edition season key (END year (2024-25 = 2025)). Omitted = the newest edition that has started; a game function needs season or comp. For fiba_bcla_editions(): the first season (inclusive), omitted = every edition.

to_season

Last season, inclusive (fiba_bcla_editions() only).

comp

FIBA competition id (one per edition); skips the edition lookup and is needed when a season lists several editions. Checked to be an edition of this competition (one cached getGdapCompetitionById request).

return_parsed

Parse the payload into a tibble (default TRUE); FALSE returns the raw JSON list.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with the columns of the base wrapper (the raw JSON list when return_parsed = FALSE), one table per function:

fiba_bcla_editions()

The columns of fiba_gdap_editions():

col_nametypedescription

fiba_bcla_pbp()

The columns of fiba_gamepage_pbp():

col_nametypedescription
game_idintegerFIBA game id (Int64), global across competitions: gdapGameId, the <gameId> of a game-page URL.
competition_idintegerFIBA competition id (Int64) of the game's edition; the comp argument.
statistic_systemcharacterLive-stats system of the game: OVR (World Cup, Olympics) or FLS (club competitions, most qualifiers); they differ in the play-by-play action ids, order and text.
periodcharacterPeriod name: Q1..Q4, then OT1, OT2...
period_numberinteger1-based position of the period in the game.
action_idcharacterAction id (String): '<n>:<seq>' in OVR games (3:0015), a sequence number in FLS games; unique within the game.
orderintegerSort key within the period (OVR: 1, 2, ...; FLS: 1000, 2000, ...); null on some period events.
clockcharacterGame clock: time REMAINING in the period, 'm:ss', counting down from 10:00 (5:00 in overtime).
clock_secondsintegerSeconds remaining in the period, derived from clock.
wall_time_msnumericWall-clock time of the action, Unix epoch milliseconds. (Int64 in sdv-py; numeric here, the values exceed R's 32-bit integer range)
score_aintegerTeam A score after the action.
score_bintegerTeam B score after the action.
action_codecharacterAction code: P2 two-point shot, P3 three-point shot, FT free throw, REB rebound, TREB team rebound, ASS assist, ST steal, BS block, TO turnover, TTO team turnover, FOUL foul, RFOUL foul drawn, SUBST substitution, TIMO timeout, plus period events (STARTG, STARTP, ENDP, ENDG).
action_familycharacterAction family: shot, subst, timeout, periods, and 'unknwown' (FIBA's spelling) for every other action.
descriptioncharacterEnglish action text ('3pt jump shot missed', 'defensive rebound'); null on most OVR actions.
organisation_idintegerStable federation or club id (Int64) of the team, the same in every competition (64 = Germany); the page's T_<id> and the play-by-play oId. NOT the per-competition team_id.
team_sidecharacterA or B: whether the row is the schedule's team A or team B (null when the page does not say).
player_idintegerFIBA person id (Int64), global across competitions and roles: the page's P_<id>, play-by-play pId, roster personId and fiba_gdap_roster.player_id.
player2_idintegerFIBA person id (Int64) of the second player on a substitution; null when the game does not record it (the refs note FLS only, but the Paris 2024 final, an OVR game, carries it and the FLS games sampled leave it null).
sub_directioncharacterSubstitution direction: IN or OUT; null on other actions.
madelogicalTrue when the shot went in (two-pointers, three-pointers and free throws only; null otherwise).
points_attemptedintegerPoints the attempt was worth (2, 3 or 1), made or not; null on other actions.
shot_typecharacterShot type derived from action_code: 2PT, 3PT or FT; null on other actions.
shot_xintegerShot x, integer pixels on a half-court image across the court width (observed 0-278, basket near x = 139). Present only on shots; free throws are 0. Which sideline is x = 0 and the scale are UNVERIFIED.
shot_yintegerShot y, integer pixels from the baseline (y = 0) towards midcourt (observed 0-224, basket near y = 25); both teams' shots are drawn on one basket. Free throws are 0. Scale UNVERIFIED.
has_locationlogicalTrue when shot_x / shot_y locate the shot (two- and three-pointers); False for free throws (always 0, 0); null on other actions.

Details

FIBA's terms restrict this source: the GDAP developer-portal terms limit API use to 'Authorized Users' and the fiba.basketball terms say no portion of the site may be duplicated, redistributed or manipulated. The package owner reviewed both clauses on 2026-10-12, accepted them and approved the full intake, published data releases included. Users who are not themselves authorised by FIBA should check the terms before using the wrappers. See fiba_gdap_awards() for the shared notes.

A comp of another competition family, or one GDAP gives no family, is hoopR_asset_fetch; a season with no edition is hoopR_no_data; a season listing several editions, or a game function called with neither season nor comp, is hoopR_bad_request.

 fiba_bcla_editions(season = 2025)
 fiba_bcla_schedule(season = 2025)
